method: Grate the paneer. Mash the boiled potatoes.
Mix the grated paneer, mashed potatoes, chopped green chilies, ginger (or ginger-garlic paste), maida, salt, and chopped coriander leaves together well.
Shape the mixture into small balls.
Place some chopped cashews and raisins inside each ball and roll them closely.
Heat refined oil in a pan. Once hot, drop the balls in and fry until golden brown. Set the fried koftas aside.
For the gravy, heat oil in a pan and add chopped onions. Fry until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and stir until the raw smell leaves.
Add the chopped green chilies, followed by the chopped tomatoes.
Add chili powder, turmeric powder, and coriander powder. Sauté well, then add salt.
Add the cashew paste and some coriander leaves. Pour in a little water and stir.
Add garam masala powder, then cumin powder.
Finally, add the cream and immediately remove the pan from heat.
Pour this hot gravy over the already fried koftas.
